purpose: Independently generated synthetic VP8 keyframes for large native media transport tests
generator: ffmpeg 9.0.1, existing installation; no downloaded or user-provided media
verified: ffmpeg decoded all 768 frames without error
ffmpeg seek to 58s decoded two distinct frames
validation_scope: Fixture validity only. This does not establish Tauri or WebKit native playback acceptance.

acceptance_routes.small_video_and_audio: Production Core loopback /fs HTTP streaming, matching the all-platform media route
acceptance_routes.image_owner_isolation: Production native resource scheme; independent 32x24 RGB PNG generated with Python standard-library zlib and CRC32

http_range_evidence: Independent Rust HTTP client probes the production route. WebView HTTP request headers are not observed.

headless_audio.method: In the isolated child only, set existing hardware Audio/Sink and device-provider ranks to zero. GStreamer autoaudiosink selects its clock-synchronized coreelements fakesink when no hardware candidates remain.
not_used: host audio server or physical speaker
headless_audio.required_runtime_evidence: Actual fake-audio-sink rendered-buffer debug record plus successful real WebView media time/decode assertions. Environment variables alone do not establish success.
headless_audio.validation_scope: Media decoding and playback timing, not physical speaker output. Runtime package versions are recorded separately on each run.

window_isolation.document: A test-only Assets provider supplies one static empty HTML document through the existing Tauri App protocol; the production resource protocol still rejects HTML
window_isolation.profile: Both windows use the same disposable child-owned profile and must report the same nonopaque tauri://localhost origin
order: owner PNG load/decode and completed production 200
foreign exact URL image error and production 403
destroy owner and confirm scope closure
foreign exact URL image error and production 404
window_isolation.cache_policy: The harness does not clear caches, change resource URLs, override request cache policy, or modify response headers. Production PNG success and denial responses must carry Cache-Control: no-store. The owner image remains attached until owner destruction.
window_isolation.observations: Global monotonic request, response and controller-stage sequences; request and response Cache-Control; Content-Type; actual page origins
window_isolation.limits: Shared profile and origin do not establish renderer sharing or a cache hit. An image error without the matching production status fails. All four media cases use the production HTTP route and retain strict playback, decoded-frame, seek and cancellation assertions.
window_isolation.startup_diagnostics: Page-load started/finished, script submission, JavaScript startup/media/image stages, errors/rejections and WebKit process termination are retained in Rust. JavaScript uses an acknowledged, sequential test-only Tauri command; titles carry no data. Bounded eval queries read the final transport state and failure diagnostics as native objects serialized once by Tauri.
window_isolation.window_layout: The two visible child-owned windows use nonoverlapping 480x480 layouts inside the private 1024x768 Xvfb surface. Actual geometry/visibility are recorded and checked; no host display or throttling setting is changed.

report_transport.method: Test-builder-only native_media_report command with typed packets and sequential acknowledgements
report_transport.validation: Actual requesting WebView label and exact Tauri App URL; strict packet sequence; Rust receipt evidence; rejected/overflowed/missing reports fail
report_transport.permissions: No production command, capability, dependency or ACL configuration change; local App-origin custom commands are allowed by the existing Tauri application without an app ACL manifest
report_transport.regression_scope: Pure-script helper tests cover long reports, acknowledgement ordering/mismatch, queue and message bounds, asynchronous cancellation states, seek-reset quality counters and missing/stale video frames. They are not native GUI acceptance.
report_transport.completion: Before destroying the owner and after Core shutdown for the foreign window, a bounded query requires pending=0, acknowledged=sequence and failure=null. The final settling interval consumes diagnostics; fatal events received during shutdown also fail the result.

video_frame_evidence.method: requestVideoFrameCallback must provide at least two actual callbacks with increasing mediaTime while playback time advances; no time-only fallback
video_frame_evidence.quality_counter: Recorded diagnostically; not assumed monotonic across GStreamer seek/flush

cancel_evidence.method: After emptied, require NETWORK_EMPTY, HAVE_NOTHING, paused, not seeking, no src/srcObject/source children, empty buffered/seekable ranges, and 300ms without time or new video-frame progress. Reload must still play. Immediate, final and timeout states are retained.
cancel_evidence.current_src: Classify as empty, original fixture, or other without logging the URL. WebKit 2.52.6 retains m_currentSrc when replacing the old player on a no-source load; the string is not a release indicator.

playback_diagnostics.method: Observe media events and periodic state samples concurrently with the unchanged 12-second play-promise guard. Pending promise, actual progress and final state survive failure; progress does not substitute for promise fulfillment.
playback_diagnostics.limits: Each observation retains first/latest 40 events and 16 state samples with counts. Each time-range list retains at most four ranges. Detailed observations use separate existing diagnostic packets; final results retain compact playback summaries.
playback_diagnostics.pipeline: Enable the existing webkitmediaplayer debug category only in the owned child. Retain first 8/latest 24 relevant state lines and first 16 seek lines per pipeline, at most 12 pipelines and 480 characters per line, with URL redaction. Synthetic element IDs correlate fixtures with pipeline names.
playback_diagnostics.unresolved: Large WAV seek play-promise timeout needs real pipeline evidence; no increased timeout, retry, preload change or route change is applied.
